scientific_context.boundary: The public EquiFACS EAD103/EAD104 descriptions are only an appearance sanity reference. Final feline coding must not claim certified CatFACS equivalence without CatFACS-specific reviewer competence or separately validated automation.

timing.frame_set: all decoded frames in chronological order
timing.onset_definition: first decoded frame judged PRESENT, immediately preceded by a decoded frame judged ABSENT
timing.forbidden_onset_bridge: UNCERTAIN or NOT_VISIBLE cannot serve as the previous ABSENT frame
timing.latency_interval_rule: for signaller (s_prev,s] and responder (r_prev,r], point=r-s and acquisition interval=[r_prev-s, r-s_prev]

appearance_sanity_reference.EAD103: ear flattener: pinna/ear is pulled caudally and flattened toward the head; do not infer this label from landmark displacement alone
appearance_sanity_reference.EAD104: ear rotator: pinna rotates caudally/laterally; distinguish rotation from flattening; the two actions may co-occur
appearance_sanity_reference.species_boundary: wording is a cross-species public FACS sanity reference, not a substitute for the CatFACS manual

candidate_channels.cat_A_tabby_left: tabby/brown cat, left/foreground in the frozen short source
candidate_channels.cat_B_black_right: black cat, right/background in the frozen short source

identity.final_identity_requirement: reviewer must confirm identity continuity on every onset-supporting frame; fixed ROI labels alone are candidate identity, not proof

occlusion_and_quality.partial_occlusion_rule: if the relevant pinna contour/orientation cannot be judged, label NOT_VISIBLE or UNCERTAIN rather than inferring the action
occlusion_and_quality.exposure_change_rule: exposure/brightness changes cannot establish action onset
occlusion_and_quality.head_motion_rule: global head rotation cannot establish an ear action unless ear motion relative to the head is separately visible

independence.phase_A_final_manual_labels: independent reviewer sees chronological raw frame pairs/crops and decoded PTS but no landmark overlay, motion score, model ranking, or predicted action
independence.phase_B_model_comparison: only after phase_A labels are frozen and hashed may model/landmark triage scores be revealed
independence.reason: the current analysis has already inspected landmark overlays and model-derived motion rankings, so it cannot be used as the blinded independent action coder

model_triage.purpose: prioritize debugging and model-development inspection only

matching.ear_laterality_policy: same CatFACS action may be compared regardless of left/right laterality only if the final preregistered analysis explicitly records the laterality channel; never silently collapse it

claim_ceiling: This protocol freezes how EAD103/EAD104 candidates must be reviewed and timed. It contains no action labels and establishes no facial-action onset, mimicry event, delta-t, or feline reaction-time estimate.
